title: Flood Release Floor on a Due-and-Payable Summit Loan
content:
Set-Aside Accounts — Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve, returned flood premiums.

Where the loan's maturity case (Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases) that is due and payable or in its extension period records an intent to sell the property or to give a deed in lieu, the flood release floor is the leaving-home release floor, 0.00. Where that case records an intent to retain the property, the flood release floor is the retaining release floor, 25.00. Where no such intent is recorded, or no such case exists, this rule does not set the floor.

A flood refund excess is released to the borrower's side only when it is above zero and at least the floor; below the floor it stays in the reserve.

| Hypothetical flood refund excess | Intent to sell or deed in lieu (floor 0.00) | Intent to retain (floor 25.00) |
|---|---|---|
| 10.00 | Released | Stays in the reserve |
| 25.00 | Released | Released |
| 0.00 | Nothing to release | Nothing to release |
